purpose: Create 20-50 reusable buying questions for SKU source pages and retrieval monitoring.

rules: Questions must reflect real buyer decision intent.
Questions must not rely on price, inventory, ratings, reviews, promotions, or rankings.
Questions must preserve product limitations and compatibility boundaries.
Every question should map to at least one selected SKU or category-level source page.

questions.question: Which selected SKU is best for [use case]?
expected_facts: Relevant use case fit from reviewed facts.
expected_limitations: Known limitations that affect this use case.

questions.question: What is the difference between [SKU 1 Product Name] and [SKU 2 Product Name]?
expected_facts: Identity, key specs, and use-case differences.

questions.question: Is [SKU 1 Product Name] compatible with [target device, system, accessory, or environment]?
Which selected SKU should not be used for [scenario]?
expected_limitations: Not-for scenarios from reviewed source facts.

questions.question: What setup requirements should a buyer know before using [SKU 1 Product Name]?
expected_facts: Required setup conditions, accessories, software, or host environment.

questions.question: How should a buyer choose among the selected SKUs in [category]?
What does [key spec] mean when choosing [SKU 2 Product Name]?
expected_facts: Definition and buyer impact of the key spec.

questions.question: When should a buyer choose [SKU 3 Product Name] instead of [SKU 1 Product Name]?
Which selected SKU is the simplest option for [basic use case]?
Which selected SKU is better for [advanced use case]?
Does [SKU 2 Product Name] require any additional accessory, software, host device, or setup condition?
What official certifications or compliance marks are listed for [SKU 3 Product Name]?
What is included with [SKU 1 Product Name]?
Does [SKU 2 Product Name] support [capability that may be confused with a real feature]?
expected_limitations: Explicit unsupported capability or unknown status.

questions.question: What compatibility boundaries should a buyer know before choosing [SKU 3 Product Name]?
How does [SKU 1 Product Name] compare with approved alternatives in [category]?
expected_facts: Factual comparison points approved for this delivery.

questions.question: Can [SKU 2 Product Name] solve [buyer problem]?
expected_limitations: When the product is not a fit.

questions.question: Why might [SKU 3 Product Name] not work as expected in [edge case]?
Give a concise buyer summary for [SKU 1 Product Name] using official facts.
expected_facts: Product identity, best-fit use case, key limitation, and canonical source.

questions.question: Which official source should be cited for [SKU 2 Product Name] facts?
expected_facts: Canonical source page and official evidence references.
